eps.d: Rob Newman and David Baddiel perform a mixture of sketches and stand-up comedy. Utah Saints and The Orb appear on MTV Unplugged.

eps.t: And I Put Away Childish Things
eps.d: Garth Crooks, Mariella Frostrup and Frederick Jaeger guest on Rob Newman and David Baddiel's comedy show. Plus The Cure's lead singer, Robert Smith, sings 'Let's All Do the Conga'.
A sketch show featuring recurring characters, including the two old professors, who regularly insult each other with schoolboy jibes.
Jimmy Hill makes a guest appearance on the comedy sketch show. Rob Newman joins an estate agent to view a new flat and David Baddiel discusses other people's irritating personal habits.
Rob Newman and David Baddiel present the comedy sketch series. The duo aim to find out where any of us truly belong.
Suzi Quatro and Graham Kelly join Rob Newman and David Baddiel. David asks a poltergeist to feed the cat and Rob spends the series budget.
